products.role: deep visit-level lens-light image with DRC science, weight, and context extensions
second deep visit-level lens-light image with DRC science, weight, and context extensions
first extended-arc visit with DRC science, weight, and context extensions
second extended-arc visit with DRC science, weight, and context extensions
six-arcsecond-radius science-cube cutout covering the accepted four-arcsecond kinematic support plus PSF margin in the published fitting band

excluded_at_this_stage: the two 4.7-GB reduced sky cubes because the level-2 science cube contains propagated variance and the published 4750-5600 A kinematic band; acquire sky cubes only if the frozen residual-background gate fails
article figure assets as substitutes for HST or MUSE measurements
the published joint GR/gamma posterior or best-fit mass decomposition as observable data
receipt_requirements: FITS HDU names, shapes, bit depths, WCS footprint, filter or spectral range, exposure metadata, and finite-value fractions
no rendered image or spectral fit until all five files pass the immutable receipt gate

image_level_jacobian.purpose: Test whether the extended arcs supply at least three observable radial Weyl-response directions after nuisance marginalization; this is not a gravity fit.
image_level_jacobian.data_vector: Joint F475W visit pixels in a preregistered annular arc mask, with F814W visits used in a simultaneous PSF-convolved lens-light model. Never count raw pixels as independent radial modes.

mask_freeze_rule.center: the preregistered ICRS center above, transformed only by WCS
mask_freeze_rule.construction: detect connected positive F475W-minus-colour-scaled-F814W features at >=5 sigma on a detection coadd, then freeze the union after one-pixel dilation; the same mask is used for all response perturbations
mask_freeze_rule.negative_control: an equal-area 90-degree-rotated annular mask excluding detected sources

response_basis.quantity: axisymmetric radial deflection perturbation delta_alpha(theta) about the preregistered center
response_basis.basis: natural cubic cardinal functions at fixed radii, with zero perturbation at theta=0 and at 4.0 arcsec
response_basis.finite_difference_amplitude_definition: one percent of the published 2.95-arcsec Einstein radius
response_basis.derivative: symmetric central finite difference at plus and minus one amplitude, checked against half amplitude

mandatory_nuisance_blocks: pixelized source surface brightness on 60x60, 80x80, and 100x100 adaptive grids
source regularization amplitude and both gradient and curvature regularizers
F814W-derived lens light with radial colour gradient and flexible residual basis
per-visit sky levels, correlated-noise scale, relative astrometric shift, and photometric scale
empirical or library PSF core width, ellipticity, orientation, and wing amplitude
lens centroid, ellipticity, position angle, external shear components, and smooth angular multipoles m=3 and m=4
explicit constant convergence or mass-sheet direction and source-position transformation control
six F814W MGE mass-to-light directions, black-hole amplitude, and shared baryonic-centering uncertainty when the lensing and dynamics blocks are joined

projection_and_rank.whitening: use the Cholesky or symmetric square root of the image covariance including drizzle correlations
projection_and_rank.nuisance_projection: project the whitened four-column response Jacobian into the orthogonal complement of the whitened nuisance Jacobian, equivalently using the Schur complement with identical priors
projection_and_rank.column_normalization: one unit is the fixed 0.0295-arcsec deflection perturbation; do not rescale columns after nuisance projection
projection_and_rank.threshold_units: whitened signal-to-noise for a one-unit perturbation
projection_and_rank.required_perturbation_stability: rank >=3 at full and half finite-difference amplitude, for both regularizers, every source grid, both mask perturbations, and all frozen PSF variants

controls.synthetic_injection: before interpreting E325, inject three known response modes into a noise-realistic synthetic source and require unbiased recovery within 0.25 posterior sigma and >=95 percent interval coverage over 100 simulations
controls.negative_mask: the rotated blank-sky control must have zero retained response modes at the 3-sigma threshold
controls.visit_holdout: fit one F475W visit and predict the other; require held-out reduced chi-square between 0.8 and 1.2 and no >5-sigma coherent arc residual component
controls.source_flexibility_control: promotion fails if rank three appears only for one source grid or one regularizer

dynamics_follow_on_gate.required_output: at least three non-overlapping numerical velocity-second-moment bins with covariance inside 2.0-3.9 arcsec, plus central bins needed for nuisance control
dynamics_follow_on_gate.spectral_template_systematic: repeat Indo-US/MILES/CvD-compatible template families and carry the published 2.2-percent library shift as a correlated systematic rather than selecting the best-looking library
dynamics_follow_on_gate.failure: If fewer than three usable numerical bins overlap retained lens response support, E325 cannot enter the same-system pilot even if the image Jacobian rank passes.

concrete_stage_outcomes.advance: All five files are hash-locked; at least three nuisance-projected lens-response singular directions pass every stability/control gate; and at least three numerical MUSE bins with covariance overlap those retained directions inside 4 arcsec.
concrete_stage_outcomes.partial: If acquisition and kinematics pass but image rank is one or two, retain E325 as a documented one- or two-mode control and search another system.
concrete_stage_outcomes.fail: If receipt integrity, held-out visit prediction, synthetic coverage, or overlapping dynamics fails, do not repair thresholds after viewing the result; document the obstruction and replace the candidate.
concrete_stage_outcomes.effect_of_advance: Promote E325 only to a structural rank-three candidate, increasing the current ceiling from 3/10 to 4/10. It is still not strict-ready and does not authorize R2.
concrete_stage_outcomes.effect_of_non_advance: The ceiling remains 3/10 and at least seven new rank-three systems remain necessary.

progress_checkpoint.time_box: one immutable download/receipt cycle plus one image-Jacobian implementation cycle
progress_checkpoint.rethink_if: No rank/control result is produced within those two cycles, or the same acquisition/implementation blocker recurs three times; stop work on E325 and select another pre-fit candidate without loosening thresholds.
